description: Parameters of 4-states synchronous machine: Simplified Marconato model The derivative of stator fluxes (ψd and ψq) is neglected and ωψd = ψd and ωψq = ψq is assumed (i.e. ω=1.0). This is standard when transmission network dynamics is neglected

id.description: Unique integer identifier for this component

base_power.description: Base power for this model's per-unit parameters. Usually equal to the `base_power` of the dynamic injection that names this model; the ingestion layer reconciles a difference. Units: MVA.

Xd_p.description: Transient reactance after EMF in d-axis

Xq_p.description: Transient reactance after EMF in q-axis

Td0_p.description: Time constant of transient d-axis voltage

Tq0_p.description: Time constant of transient q-axis voltage

title: OneDOneQMachine
